case_title: LOPEZ PABLO VS GROGERS WESTERN WEAR

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $341.39 FILED BY LOPEZ PABLO AS TO DEFENDANT GROGERS WESTERN WEAR ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-29-1994 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 07

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LOPEZ PABLO IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT GROGERS WESTERN WEAR DEFENDANT ORDERED TO REUTN BOOTS TO PLAINTIFF STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
